name: Doto Koi
source:
A spin-off of "Doto Koi (どとこい)". The protagonist, Takahashi Pon (name changeable) transfers to a Tokyo school at the beginning of her second year of high school.
On her first day, she accidentally bumps into... a square?! The protagonist has been "blessed" with a spell that lowers the resolution of good looking guys!

"Dot Koi" is a simple romance adventure game. At first, the handsome guys will have very low resolution and will only appear as ■, but as their affection level rises, their sprites will gradually change, and eventually they'll appear human again. 

(Note: The only difference between the paid ver and the free ver is that the paid ver is fully voiced).
translation:
本作是《どとこい》的衍生作品。主角Takahashi Pon（姓名可更改）在高二開學時轉入東京的一所學校。
第一天，她不小心撞上了……一個方塊？！原來，主角被施加了「讓帥哥的解析度降低」的「祝福」！

《ドトコイ》是一款簡單的戀愛冒險遊戲。起初，帥哥們的解析度極低，看起來只有一個「■」。但隨著好感度提升，他們的立繪會逐漸變化，最終重新顯現出人類的模樣。

（註：付費版與免費版的唯一區別是，付費版為全語音。）
